blurb: Jack's Charter Service offers year-round fishing charters on Lake Michigan including salmon, trout, and steelhead fishing, as well as guided ice fishing trips for trophy brown trout and steelhead. They provide all rods, reels, tackle, and bait needed. Trips operate from Milwaukee and Racine with experienced captains and modern boats.
